title: This is not a regular diagnostic; instead, it's raised when a file cannot be read from disk.
summary: An IOError indicates an error in the development setup. For example, the user may not have permissions to read a given file, or the filesystem may contain a broken symlink. Ruff takes this rule from pycodestyle and made it stable in v0.0.28.

title: Checks for code that contains syntax errors.
summary: Code with syntax errors cannot be executed. Such errors are likely a mistake. Ruff takes this rule from pycodestyle, and removed it.
